comments.author: tomaarsen
comments.body:
Hello!

Thanks for raising this. This wasn't caught by my CI: `transformers` and `huggingface_hub` have dropped their dependency on `requests`, and I hadn't included it in `sentence-transformers`' dependencies despite using it in `file_io`. The easy fix is to include it for `sentence-transformers`, but I may instead follow `transformers` and `huggingface_hub` and move to `httpx`.

Apologies for the inconvenience. I'll try to have it patched tomorrow.

- Tom Aarsen
